arguments.name: sftp
arguments.description: Connection credentials: host, port (1-65535), user and either password or key_filename. Keep them in the vault as a JSON object and pass ${entv:namespace/key}.

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Local file or directory to upload (put), or remote path to download (get) or list (list); not used by mkdir.

arguments.name: destination
arguments.description: Remote destination (put, mkdir) or local destination (get); optional for list.

arguments.name: archive
arguments.description: Archive the transferred files (put and get only): enabled (default false) and filename_policy.

arguments.name: settings
arguments.description: Optional SSH settings: connection {timeout, banner_timeout, auth_timeout}, algorithms {kex, host_key, cipher, mac} and host_key {policy: known_hosts or auto_add}.

outputs.name: entries
outputs.description: Directory entries returned by the list operation.
